context:
Goal: you review only what needs your word, not all 31.
Problem (rule): the retrospective checked the 33 rulings that carry your 11:47 CST Nov 12 source against main. 16 are new, 6 are already ruled, 9 change a rule and 2 conflict. Only the 2 conflicts need a pick now. (1) merge-lock-gitlock-on-mac says GitLock on a Mac; decision merge-lock says GitLock only in the cloud, GhLock otherwise. (2) sim-drive-needs-lease says a sim drive takes a lease; sim-lease-tool item 4 and sim-test-is-the-one-boot-path rule 5 say the reuse path takes no lease.
The 9 that change a rule (not asked here, the retrospective's reading in brackets): close-replaced-at-open [owner words; may be narrowed by your 11:45 'batch runner closes']; guard-imports-fail-closed [ruling looks right]; dead-host-lock-keeps-tree [unclear; ruling says owner pick, PR 2783 says coordinator pick]; past-head-fail-own-commit [ruling looks right]; record-first-needs-shas and record-own-rounds-withdrawn [coordinator pick, not owner]; pr-ledger-stack-by-base-ref [every limit unmeasured, your R37]; retire-run-lane-tip-deferred [loosens a check]; page-tests-served-font [a lane CI run main forbids]. Two rulings the item missed: close-replaced-at-open, dead-host-lock-keeps-tree.
Based on (read): retrospective audit, main fccff95e, roadmap 5da6664b.
Departs from: main — a keeps main on both; b changes main to match the rulings.
Meanwhile: the 9 changes wait; I bring them one at a time if you want.

options.gain: No change to main; the two rulings stop contradicting it.
options.how: The two rulings are rewritten to match main: GitLock only in the cloud for the merge lock, and the reuse path takes no lease for the sim drive.
options.label: Main's decisions win on both (retrospective's reading, recommended)
options.lose: Your 11:47 words on these two are narrowed.
